name: Belladonna
essence: The state of intense congestion and violent onset. Characterized by redness, bellicose heat, and throbbing pains that appear and disappear suddenly.

name: Aconite
essence: The storm before the calm. Dominated by acute, sudden panic and a predictive fear of death, typically following exposure to dry, cold wind.

name: Arsenicum Album
essence: Profound insecurity manifesting as fastidiousness and extreme restlessness. Burning pains that are paradoxically relieved by heat.

name: Bryonia
essence: The remedy of extreme dryness and aggravation from the slightest motion. The patient is irritable and deeply concerned about their business/material security.

name: Nux Vomica
essence: The over-stressed, sedentary urbanite. A state of hyper-irritability, competitive drive, and ineffective urges (in-effectual straining).
